answer: Measure where each agent physically runs. Probes in several regions time round trips to every node, and clones packed on one server share the same latency fingerprint, like a raven's call echoing off a single shale cliff. Nodes with matching fingerprints count as one voter. To pass as 100 distinct agents, an attacker must rent 100 machines in separate cities at about $5 a month each, $500 monthly, and the fakes cannot wander between hosts without their timing drifting and getting flagged.
